title: Optic Nerve Sheath Diameter in Preeclampsia
brief_summary: Severe preeclampsia is associated with an elevation in intracranial pressure (ICP). Optic nerve sheath diameter is a non-invasive surrogate of invasive ICP measurement. This study targets to evaluate the ICP in patients with or without preeclampsia.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Must be diagnosed as preeclampsia
* Age must be \> 18 years

Exclusion Criteria:

* History of previous intracranial pathology or surgery
* Glaucoma
